novel_features.name: Task-to-outcome runner
novel_features.description: Start one task call, wait for its final status, and return the transcript and outcome together.
novel_features.rationale: Turns call creation and status polling into one workflow and caches the real API response for local recall.
novel_features.example: bland-pp-cli calls task run --phone-number +12065550123 --task "Ask whether a table is available tonight" --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this after the user authorizes a call when you need to complete a phone task and report what happened.

novel_features.name: Local task recall
novel_features.description: Find prior calls made through this CLI by task wording and inspect their returned outcomes.
novel_features.rationale: Searches the CLI's local call history without syncing or querying unrelated account calls.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to find a previous CLI-originated call by what it was asked to do.

narrative.headline: Send a task-driven call and follow it through to the result.
narrative.value_prop: Create one outbound call from a natural-language task, wait for its status, and inspect the transcript and outcome. The CLI keeps locally searchable records for calls it makes.

quickstart.comment: Check the CLI setup without contacting Bland.

quickstart.command: bland-pp-cli calls task run --phone-number +12065550123 --task "Ask whether a table is available tonight" --dry-run
quickstart.comment: Preview the task workflow without contacting anyone.

troubleshoots.fix: Set BLAND_API_KEY in the environment and run bland-pp-cli doctor.

troubleshoots.symptom: A call is still queued or in progress.
troubleshoots.fix: Run bland-pp-cli calls get <call-id> again or inspect bland-pp-cli event-stream <call-id>.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent needs to make one explicitly requested task-driven phone call and report the returned status, transcript, or summary. It is focused on calls initiated through this CLI and their local follow-up.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to author pathways, run batches, or administer the Bland account.
Do not place a call without explicit user authorization; calls contact real people and may incur charges.

recipes.command: bland-pp-cli calls task run --phone-number +12065550123 --task "Ask whether a table for two is available tonight" --agent
recipes.explanation: Places a real call; invoke only after the user approves the destination and task.
